installation.approval_quote: Approved. Proceed with the full Playwright + Chromium installation inside this session's isolated sandbox. Use a Python virtual environment rather than modifying the system Python installation. ... Do not use security-bypassing browser flags automatically.
steps: python3 -m venv /tmp/pw-venv && /tmp/pw-venv/bin/pip install playwright  (playwright 1.63.0, greenlet 3.5.6, pyee 13.0.1)

@sparticuz/chromium executablePath() inflated 67 MB brotli payload to /tmp/chromium (chrome-headless-shell build, 209 MB)

installation.security_flags_policy: @sparticuz/chromium default args include --no-sandbox, --disable-web-security, --allow-running-insecure-content; these were NOT used. Browser launched with sandbox enabled and only --disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-gpu.
installation.resource_observation: install footprint ~350 MB in /tmp (venv ~60 MB, node_modules ~85 MB, inflated binary 209 MB); launch time 120 ms; no measurable system impact afterwards.
installation.persistence_assessment: NOT persistent across sessions: venv, node_modules and /tmp/chromium live in /tmp (outside the persisted workspace); ~/.cache/ms-playwright was never populated; apt is unusable (mirror blocked) so a system-level install is impossible in this sandbox. Only committed repository files persist. Recreating the browser requires the same npm-based path again (registry.npmjs.org allowlisted).
